scope.files: Production src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.tsx and src/**/*.css; test/spec/declaration files excluded.
scope.styleDetection: TypeScript AST style-like string/template literals and numeric inline fontSize/borderRadius; PostCSS declarations and @apply. Prose/comments are excluded.
scope.semanticColors: Configured Tailwind semantic color families plus surface/action/status; built-in colors, named typography, arbitrary expressions and custom non-semantic classes are not guessed.
scope.sizes: Simple literal px/rem typography, radius, dimensions and spacing in utilities/inline properties/CSS declarations; var/calc/percent expressions and SVG attributes are excluded. Existing seat-map style dimensions retain counted precision exceptions.
scope.cssTokens: var(--token) without fallback must have a declaration somewhere in production CSS or a TS custom-property assignment/setProperty. Tailwind --tw-* generated properties excluded.
scope.budget: Every exemption/unresolved item is counted by exact file/rule/value; removals pass and increases fail. New exceptions require a reviewed source update, reason and owner.
